data.name: Maximum Firerate
data.description:
You make 8 attacks against the target. You roll these salvo attacks in pairs of two rather than all at the same time. Any reactions from an enemy are still valid against all 8 like a normal salvo.

After every 2 attacks, you may choose to cancel further attacks. You regain 1 mana spent on this ability for every 2 shots you did not fire due to cancelling.
data.requirement: Must be made with a pistol, musket or crossbow.

data.name: Measured Collapse
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack is always considered to have rolled a 2 for accuracy instead of rolling the d20.

Against creatures that are large size, gain a +2 bonus. If they are huge size, gain a +4 bonus.

data.name: Medusa's Glance
data.description:
You flare your mystic eye as you are attacked.

The attacker must avert their eyes and become Blinded 5 until the attack resolves or begin to suffer to partial petrification. They lose 1 RP and gain 1 stack of Calcification.
data.requirement: You are the target of a melee attack.

data.name: Memory of the Grove
data.description: After making a gathering check, you may choose to reroll the die. If you do, store the original die result. You may replace a future gathering die result (before bonus) with the stored value.
data.requirement: Usable after making a gathering a check.

data.name: Mercantile
data.description: You start with the Merchant class unlocked and at level 1.

data.name: Meteor Cleave
data.description:
You sidestep up to 10ft towards the target and make a melee Heavy attack against them. 

On damage, if your power is equal or higher than the target's, they are knocked Prone.

data.name: Mighty Leap
data.description: You jump to a target within range and may make a Light attack against them. All enemies within 5ft of the target must make a save or become Unbalanced.

data.name: Mind Connection
data.description:
You physically touch up to five willing people, granting them Mind Connection—creating a mind link through you.  While linked, each creature can speak through telepathy to all other creatures linked to the same caster.  Mind Connection has unlimited duration but also reduces your maximum mana by 1, this effect lasts until you cancel Mind Connection.  Mind Connection has a maximum range of 500 ft—breaking this range doesn’t cancel the spell but interrupts the signal until within range again.

While Mind Connection lasts, you may spend 1 AP to transfer view through the eyes of one of the people connected with the mind link. While viewing through the eyes of other people, you are considered to be Blinded 5 for the purpose of making attacks that are not made through Conduit.

data.name: Mind's Eye
data.description: You may ask the GM for the rough best course of action during an encounter based on the information you have. The GM should answer truthfully, but does not need to go in depth. (For example: Retreat, kill the grunts, focus the boss, use magic attacks etc).

data.name: Mining Expertise
data.description: You start with the Miner class unlocked and at level 1.

data.name: Miracle: Sanctuary
data.description: You create an immobile sphere of protection in a 5ft radius that prevents all entry into and out of it. The Shield has health points equal to 20 + Toughness x 8. Attacks and Magical Effects cannot be casted out of or into the Sanctuary, which functions as line-of-sight blocking for the purposes of abilities. Sanctuary lasts until the start of your next turn unless you pay Upkeep (1 Mana). The Spell also ends when the Shield’s health points are reduced to zero.

data.name: Misdirected Blow
data.description:
You may take the Dodge action. If the attack is successfully avoided, the attack is then made against an enemy within 5ft of you and using the same accuracy roll. This enemy must be different from the one making the attack. The new target may react to this attack as normal.

Does not work against Secret Art or Esoteric Art level attacks.
data.requirement: You are the target of an attack and have a different enemy within 5ft of you.

data.name: Mist of the Vale
data.description:
A mist rolls out from around you, trapping those caught in it in a misty vale in which travelers are doomed to die. All in the mist must make a save against your Potency when they try to escape it. If they fail their save when they attempt to move out, you may finish the remaining movement for them as long as they end within your mist. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

The mist also blocks Line of Sight. Targets inside of or within 5ft of the mist can only see up to 5ft into or out of mist.

The mist is a 15ft radius around yourself, but if flying it does not go below you. You may choose to exclude allies from the trapping effect. If you do, the upkeep mana cost and initial mana cost is increased by 1.

Upkeep: 1 AP

data.name: Molten Domain
data.description:
Until the start of your next turn, the ground 5ft around you becomes like burning ground.

Any enemy willingly leaving or moving through this area other than entering it becomes Burning X, where X is your Focus x 3.

The domain burns away other friendly damage aura effects while in effect. Effects that would normally trigger upon ending the turn in it (such as Poison Spore) don't trigger if someone ends their turn in the Molten Domain.

data.name: Momentum
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. For every 10ft moved during your last action this turn, this attack gains +1 damage up to a maximum of +10 damage. Abilities with the Teleport keyword do not apply for this.

data.name: Mordschlag
data.description: You attack the target with the pommel or crossguard making a Heavy Attack against the target.
data.requirement: Longsword, Heavy Blades and Bludgeoning weapons only.

data.name: Mountain Slayer
data.description: You make a Light attack against a target.

data.name: Mountain's Verdict
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, apply Mandate to the target.

Your next Stone Rebuke used against that target before the start of your next turn gains Lockstep.

data.name: Mounted Casting
data.description: You may cast a Spell with an AP cost of 2 or less.
data.requirement: Must be mounted and taking a movement action.

data.name: Move Piece
data.description:
You move a puppet piece you can see that's under your control. The way it moves depends on the type of piece. When a piece moves, it's a Sidestep.

Pawn: Moves up to 2 squares orthogonally or 1 square diagonally in a straight line.

Knight: Moves 1 square orthogonally, then 1 square diagonal in the same direction it moved in orthogonally (like a knight in chess). Can pass through allies and enemies.

Bishop: Moves up to 8 squares diagonally in a straight line. 

Rook: Moves up to 8 squares orthogonally in a straight line.

Queen: Moves up to 8 squares orthogonally or diagonally in a straight line.

Except for the Knight, chess pieces cannot move through allies and stop their movement when they hit an object or creature. If this happens, it makes a Heavy attack that deals Physical(Bludgeoning) damage against that target with your stats. A knight that makes an attack and does not kill the target remains in its original spot.

On damage, a piece is promoted into a higher rank (Pawn -> Bishop/Knight -> Rook -> Queen). A queen cannot promote.

On Killing Blow, a piece occupies the square of the thing it attacked.

data.name: Movement Burst
data.description:
You may move up to your Speed + up to 15ft per mana spent on this ability. Any unspent movement is lost afterwards.

If you spend more than 1 Mana on this ability, it loses the Stealth keyword.

data.name: Mud Wall
data.description:
You create a wall 4ft high, 1ft thick and up to 20ft long that serves as low cover. Anybody attempting to get over the wall treats it as difficult terrain. Walls must be placed on solid ground and cannot be stacked on top of eachother.

Each 5ft of wall has 60 HP and dissolves if it reaches 0. It otherwise lasts until the end of the encounter.

You may spend 1 RP instead of 2 AP on this ability instead.

data.name: Mudra: First Sensation
data.description:
You deliver the first motion, a graceful strike that awakens awareness in both you and your foe and you make a Light attack against the target. On hit, you gain a Harmony stack (In addition to the one you might get if this deals damage.)

Combo: When used after entering Luminous Form Stance, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

data.name: Multishot
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against two different targets. Overcharge: You may spend X extra mana to attack 2 + X targets instead.

data.name: Mystic Eyes of Life Perception
data.description: You temporarily empower your eyes. While active, you gain 360 degree vision and automatically detect all enemies within a 30ft radius of you that are not behind at least 1ft of full cover. In addition, you can see the approximate HP and Mana percentage of all enemies in this range. This lasts for 5 minutes or until you turn it off.

data.name: Nature's Grasp
data.description:
You shoot out a vine that wraps around the target and make a Light Attack against the target that only deals 1 Earth damage. On damage, the target becomes Rooted until the start of your next turn or until they spend 2 AP to remove the root with a slashing or fire based attack.

Against Grunts, this attack costs 0 Mana and gains Sure Hit.

data.name: Never Miss The Beat
data.description:
You begin singing a supportive song.

Once per round per ally, when an ally fails to meet the base evasion with an attack, you may spend 2 Mana to add that ally’s focus bonus for that attack.

Upkeep: 1 AP

data.name: Nightvision
data.description: As long as there is a source of weak light (even a weak moon) you do not suffer penalties to your vision due to darkness up to 120ft.

data.name: Ninja Run
data.description: For your next movement action, you may treat the surface you’re walking on as horizontal ground, allowing you to walk over water or up walls.

data.name: No getting past!
data.description: You may make a Light (0 RP) or Heavy (1 RP) attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Slowed until the end of their turn. If the target is already Slowed, they become Rooted.
data.requirement: Only usable when you would be able to make an attack of opportunity.

data.name: Obvious Intent
data.description: If an enemy is planning to move into a space in which it can melee attack you, you may move up to your speed away from them.
data.requirement: Can only be used at the moment an enemy declares a movement.

data.name: Offbeat Recovery
data.description:
You give your ally’s attack Lock On, but the damage is minimized (and cannot be maximized) and it loses Full Pierce, Block Crush and any on hit or on damage effects. If used after a target has already dodged, they may Block against that attack for free.

Can be used when an ally misses an ability to make it not count as a miss for your Secret Art: Full Combo (but the attack does not actually gain Lock On)
data.requirement: An ally within your Idol Song’s range misses a basic attack.

data.name: Oil Slick
data.description: You throw a bottle of oil on the ground within range, creating a 15x15 area of slippery oil. If the target contacts the oil at any point of movement (even the start or end) and they moved more than 5ft in a single movement action, they immediately fall prone. The slick lasts until the start of your next turn.

data.name: One Beat, One Heart
data.description:
All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their accuracy. This bonus is doubled on Precise attacks.

Upkeep: 1 AP

data.name: Order: Retreat
data.description: You order one willing allied unit to retreat, moving up to their Speed. All movement must be made towards you, and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

data.name: Ougi: Taju Bunshin no Jutsu
data.description:
You create 3 illusionary copies of yourself within 10ft of yourself or your Bunshin clone. These copies can take actions similar to your Bunshin Tai no Jutsu, but each of them may also act with its own 2 AP from the start of your next turn.

Each clone has 1 HP and upon taking any damage, they vanish. You may use RP for these clones as normal.

Upkeep: 2 AP

data.name: Outbreak
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, inflicts the enemy with Toxic, making them take 1d6 full pierce Poison damage at the start of their turn until they spend 2 AP to remove the poison effect.

If the target is already suffering from Toxic, instead immediately trigger the damage effect from it.
data.requirement: Must be made with a melee weapon or with a Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

data.name: Overcharge and Discount
data.description:
While on adventure, you get a 5% discount from NPC vendors, stacking with Bulk Orders if applicable, and can sell items for 10% more.

You may use an IP to give this discount effect to yourself and up to 9 other characters for that Interlude phase, for a total of a 800c discount.

data.name: Overclock
data.description: You may add 1d10 crafting points to the item. The item starts in the Broken condition. Cannot be used for Alchemy crafting.

data.name: Overpower
data.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. For every point of Power you have over the target, you deal 2 additional damage.

Combo: If used after Meteor Cleave, the AP cost is reduced by 1.

data.name: Overtime again?
data.description:
When you take the Heal Injury, Appraise or Mentor IP actions, you may do the same action again for an EP.

In addition, if you take the Rest interlude action you may give the benefit to a different character instead. This does not stack with any Rest bonuses they may have already.

data.name: Own Mount
data.description: You count as mounted for the purposes of abilities that require you to be mounted. This does not let you be a mount to other creatures.

data.name: Pack Tactics
data.description: Select a target within range. Until the end of your turn, while the target has one of your allies within 5ft of it, you gain Pack Tactics, which gives a +2 bonus on accuracy checks for melee attacks against that target.

data.name: Painkiller Injection
data.description:
You inject a willing ally with some helpful drugs to grant them temporary HP until the start of your next turn equal to your Focus x X. 

The target cannot benefit from this ability again until the end of your next turn.

data.name: Panda Roll
data.description: You prepare to roll from an incoming attack. Your next Dodge action before the start of your next turn costs 0 RP. If you successfully avoid an attack with this Dodge action, you may Sidestep 5ft.

data.name: Panda Stance
data.description:
You enter a stance in which you use your tail for extra balance. When you would be knocked back or prone, you may end this stance to negate the effect. This stance then ends.

Otherwise, the stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

You may use AP or RP for this ability.

data.name: Paragon of Virtue
data.description: You may remove a single negative non-physical effect from yourself (ie, fears, charms but not things such as bleed). If you are afflicted with more than 1 negative effect that is a valid target, you may choose which one you remove.

data.name: Parry
data.description:
Roll your Heavy Weapon Damage, but add your Focus instead of Power to the roll and treat that as your Block against the attack targeting you. If Parry reduces the damage to 0, you regain 1 RP (cannot go higher than your max RP). On hit effects and maces do not gain their effect if you reduce the damage to 0.

When using Parry against an attack, that attack cannot land a critical hit against you.
data.requirement: Target of a melee attack, wielding a One-Handed melee weapon.

data.name: Partial Petrification
data.description: The target must make a save or begin to suffer partial petrification. They lose 1 RP and gain 1 stack of Calcification.

data.name: Past Self
data.description:
You place a past self token at your current position that lasts until the end of the encounter. Your past self tokens are used for other abilities and cannot be attacked normally.

When you make a weapon attack, you may have the attack come from a past self token. After a past self token attacks, it becomes targetable by attacks and effects for 1 round as if you were in that position though you cannot be hit more than once by the same attack because of this.

Your past selves cannot be moved, willingly or forcefully.

data.name: Pathfinder
data.description: You may move up to your speed and you ignore difficult terrain penalties for this movement. Until the start of your next turn, all terrain within 20ft of you is not considered difficult terrain for your allies.

data.name: Penetrating Shot
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack penetrates through thin layers of cover such as wood planks (GM’s decision), negating the bonus it would give.

data.name: Pepper Spray
data.description:
You reach into your pocket and pull out a handful of ground chili pepper that you throw in front of you in a 15ft cube. Inflicts all targets with Pepper Spray, causing Blinded 4 and the inability to smell.  The target or an ally of the target within 5ft can spend 1 AP to wipe it off. Otherwise the effect ends at the end of the target’s next turn.

You may spend 1 RP and 1 additional mana instead of paying the AP cost.

data.name: Perfect Seasoning
data.description: Make a crafting check with a +3 Bonus.
data.requirement: Must be in a crafting session. Must have added a special ingredient (box of food, alloy materials) in your last action.

data.name: Perfect Shot
data.description:
You line up the perfect shot, striking an enemy for double Heavy Damage with Sure Hit and Full Pierce.

Automatically fails if the target has cover when this ability finishes.

data.name: Perish
data.description: You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the target that deals Dark(Curse).

data.name: Persistent Spell
data.description: If the next Spell you cast applies a buff or debuff, the duration of this buff or debuff is extended by 1 turn. If the Spell allows for a save, the target may make another save after the original effect is over to resist the duration extension.

data.name: Petrify
data.description: The target becomes permanently petrified.
data.requirement: The target has less HP than your Focus x 2.

data.name: Petrifying Gaze
data.description: You lock eyes with the target and immediately permanently petrify it.

data.name: Phantasmal Uppercut
data.description: You move your Manifestation next to an enemy within range and it makes a Heavy attack against them.

data.name: Phantom Step
data.description: You exchange positions with your Manifestation.

data.name: Phantoms of the Mist
data.description:
You conjure several phantoms in the mist and make a Light attack against all creatures within your Mist of the Vale.

You may spend 1 Mana to exclude allies from this attack.
data.requirement: Mist of the Vale must be active.

data.name: Phoenix Tears
data.description: At the end of combat you may use 1 Encounter Conclusion action to heal a single target other than yourself for Power and prevent one injury on them.

data.name: Pie Toss
data.description:
You deal 2 damage to the target. This damage can not be increased and does not trigger extra damage effects on the target.

Can be used while downed, as Encounter Start and as Encounter Conclusion.

data.name: Piercing Stab
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target and the target directly behind it.
data.range: A target in melee weapon range and a target directly behind the first target in melee weapon range.

data.name: Pillar of Earth
data.description:
You create a 5x5, 20ft high pillar below someone. The target may spend 1 RP to step out of the way.

Each block of the pillar has HP equal to 20+Focus and the entire pillar collapses if one block is removed from it.

data.name: Pinning Shot
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target with your weapon. On damage, if there is a wall or similar object directly behind the target, they become pinned against it. A pinned target is considered Rooted until they spend 2 AP to remove the arrow pinning them.

data.name: Pistol Whip
data.description:
You make a Light Attack with a pistol in your hand. On damage, the target becomes Unbalanced.

This attack benefits from alloys and material bonuses on your pistol (but not from any on your unarmed strike).

data.name: Pixie Flight
data.description: You gain controlled Flight and Hover up to your speed.  This ability ends at the start of your next turn unless you pay Upkeep 3 Mana, if you choose to not pay upkeep, you cannot use Pixie Flight until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Place Trap
data.description:
You choose to spend either 1 minute or 1 hour to place an undetermined trap in an area. You may only have 2 traps placed at a time in this way.

When an enemy comes within 20ft of you, you may spend 0 RP to determine the effects of a trap and trigger it. If you spent 1 minute, you may choose a Simple Trap. If you spent 1 hour, you may choose either a Simple Trap or a Complex Trap.

Log Swing (Simple): The target takes Light bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 20ft.

Snare (Simple): You place up to 3 snare traps, each within 20ft of each other. When triggered, the target’s movement is interrupted and they fall prone.

Net (Complex): The target is caught in a net and raised up into the air. It remains rooted there until the net is destroyed by dealing 15 damage, after which the target falls prone on the ground below it.

Pitfall (Complex): The target falls down a 5x5, 20ft deep pit and takes falling damage as normal.

A used trap cannot be reused. Setting a trap consumes a Trapper's Trap.

data.name: Plaguebringer
data.description: When you damage an enemy with a melee attack while infected with a disease or suffering from poison, you inflict that disease or poison on the enemy. They can make a save against it as normal, if the original disease or poison allowed for it.

data.name: Please Hold Still~
data.description: You apply Illumination X to the target where X is your Focus. You cannot benefit from this Illumination yourself, but also cannot consume it.

data.name: Plow the fields
data.description: You strike the ground with magical power and make a Light attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide line up to range. The terrain within this range becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Plume-Treading Art
data.description:
After each AP spent on the Move action or an ability that lets you move, you gain 1 Windflow up to a maximum of 6. Each stack of Windflow gives a +5 Windflow bonus to your movement speed. These stacks last until the end of the encounter or until you end your turn without having moved.

Cloudstep also always gives you 1 stack, up to your normal cap.

After you use Cloudstep, you treat air as regular walkable terrain until the end of your turn. At the end of your turn, if still standing on air and not Flying, you float back down to the ground without taking fall damage.

data.name: Point Blank Shot
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.

data.name: Point of Death
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals maximum damage instead of rolling for the damage.
data.requirement: Target is below half HP of their original max HP (Before True Death reductions).

data.name: Point of Death II
data.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals maximum damage instead of rolling for the damage.

On killing blow, refund the mana and AP cost spent on this ability.
data.requirement: Target is below half HP of their original max HP (Before True Death reductions).

data.name: Poison Spore
data.description:
You may spend either 2 AP or 1 RP to use this ability.

You create an Area of Poison Spores around you or the Host of Spore Symbiote. Units who end their turn in the Poison Spore take Full Pierce Poison damage equal to your Power + 2. You and the host of Spore Symbiote are immune to your own Poison Spore. Poison Spore lasts until the end of the encounter but you can only have one instance of Poison Spore active at a time.

The spore stays centered around the original target, even if the target of this ability moves. If the original target of this ability was the symbiote target and you swap the symbiote target, the location of the poison spore moves with it.
data.range: Self or The Host of Poison Spore. 15ft x 15ft Area with the target at the center.

data.name: Poison Spray
data.description: You make a Light attack against all targets in a 60ft wide, 30ft long cone. On damage, you inflict the enemy with Toxic, making them take 1d6 full pierce Poison damage at the start of their turn until they spend 2 AP to remove the poison effect.

data.name: Position Rewind
data.description: You teleport to where you were at the start of your last turn. (Use a token to mark the position)

data.name: Power Jump
data.description:
You jump up to 60ft vertically straight up into the air.  You can additionally move 5ft horizontally afterwards.  Unless flying, you automatically land straight down from your position at the end of your turn or for 0 AP, this falling movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and you don’t take fall damage from it. If you land inside an occupied square, you are shunted 5ft into an empty square (your original one if possible).

You cannot make any non-teleport movement actions while in the air unless you’re flying, but can still take other actions (such as attacking) while airborne.

data.name: Power Rock Strike
data.description: Make a gathering check at only half of your gathering bonus (rounded down) add the rolled amount to both node and lucky points.

data.name: Power Strike
data.description: You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the enemy.

data.name: Power Word: Barrier
data.description:
Up to 5 target allies within range (including yourself) gain temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to 10 + Power.

You may pay either the AP or RP cost for this ability, you don't need to pay both.

data.name: Power Word: Guardian Shield
data.description:
The target gains temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to 11 + 2 x Power. While this temporary HP lasts, on damage effects do not trigger on them unless the damage dealt does damage to their actual HP.

If this source of temporary HP is overwritten by a stronger source, this effect is lost.

data.name: Power Word: Reinforce
data.description:
The target gains temporary HP equal to 2 x their current temporary HP. 

After the attack is done resolving, the target's temporary HP is set to the value it was before this ability was used unless the target's current temporary HP is lower than that.
data.requirement: An ally is the target of an attack.

data.name: Power Word: Shield
data.description: The target gains temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to 11 + (2 x Power).

data.name: Precise Thrust
data.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.

This attack does not disable the dueling weapon ability.

data.name: Predict
data.description: You may take the Dodge action and remove the Lock On effect from the triggering attack.
data.requirement: You are the target of an attack.

data.name: Prediction
data.description: You remove the keyword Sure Hit and Lock On from the triggering attack and the target gains a +2 Dodge Bonus for their next Dodge action.
data.requirement: An ally is the target of an attack.

data.name: Prehensile Tail
data.description: You may carry objects with your tail, allowing you to interact with objects as normal even when you have both hands full. The action you are performing must not require physical strength and you cannot wield weapons with your tail.

data.name: Prepared Talisman
data.description:
You may place a Talisman on a surface or on a target within range. This costs the same amount of AP and Mana as it would normally cost and placing it on an unwilling target requires an accuracy roll that the target may dodge as normal. A target may spend AP equal to the AP cost of the talisman (before reductions) to remove the talisman from themselves.

After placing it, until the end of the encounter or for the next 5 minutes, you may spend 0 RP to instantly trigger the effect of the talisman. You cannot trigger it anymore once a talisman has been removed or is in the process of being removed and a removed talisman loses its power entirely. A talisman placed on a creature gains Sure Hit against the creature it's on when triggered.

You can only have 1 talisman prepared in this way at the same time and Sealing Talisman cannot be prepared like this. A placed talisman cannot have an AP cost of greater than 4 (or 10 seconds for casting times).

data.name: Preparedness
data.description: Up to 3 talismans, scrolls or similar objects you carry do not count towards your burden.

data.name: Presence Concealment
data.description: By suppressing your mana output you conceal your presence, gaining Presence Concealment.  You cannot use any abilites that cost mana or any abilities with the aura keyword while in Presence Concealment.  You can end this effect for 0 RP but the inability to use abilities that cost mana or abilities with the aura keyword persists until the end of your next turn.

data.name: Presence of Mind
data.description: You reduce the AP cost of your next Spell this turn by 2 AP.

data.name: Procurement
data.description:
By spending an IP, you start the procurement process.

Choose a target base item (no modifications) and an amount of that item. Determine the price of the total items and set it as the Procurement Target goal.

Every time you gain an IP, you gain 500 points towards the Procurement goal. You may also spend an IP to add another 500 points towards the goal.

When the procurement value is equal to the Procurement Target, you may immediately purchase the item. You must purchase immediately or you lose Procurement. You can cancel a Procurement at any time. The Procurement Target Limit is 1000 and for materials this is capped at materials with an ingot/block etc cost of ≤1000.

You can only have 1 Procurement active at the same time.

data.name: Prone Cover
data.description: You become Prone. While Prone from this ability, you gain the benefits of low cover against ranged attacks. In addition, all Ranged Weapon Attacks gain the Prone keyword.

data.name: Provide Milk
data.description: You may spend an EP to produce 400u worth of milk.

data.name: Provoke
data.description: You Challenge an enemy until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Provoke II
data.description: You Challenge the enemy until the end of the encounter. You may only have 1 target Challenged at the same time through this ability.

data.name: Psychometry
data.description: By touching the door to a room you gain information as to the physical layout of the room and objects within it as if you were able to see inside of the room.  By reading the Auras of all creatures within the room, you can also get a general idea of any creatures within, which you see as blobs of light—brighter for more powerful auras.  You can also use this effect on containers as well to get a general idea of the layout within containers like backpacks, and chests.  This ability can be used at unlimited range as long as a creature under the effect of Mind Connection touches the door or container.

data.name: Pull the weeds
data.description: You destroy one of your planted seeds to give yourself +5 crafting points for this session.
data.requirement: Must be in a crafting session. Only applies to a farming crafting session.

data.name: Purification Circle
data.description: You remove all stacks of single debuff from all allies in a 20ft radius circle from target point.

data.name: Purify
data.description: You cleanse a target, removing all stacks of a negative effect of your choice that you are able to identify.

data.name: Purifying Shields
data.description: You remove all stacks of a debuff from every ally within range that has temporary HP.

data.name: Quantum Bomb
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target.

data.name: Quick Artifice Reload
data.description: You quickly reload one shell into an artifice in range using one of your shells.

data.name: Quick Assist
data.description:
You teleport next to your soulmate and force the triggering attack to resolve against you, gaining the benefit of the Block action against it.

Afterwards, if your Soulmate is in range of the attacker, they may make an Attack of Opportunity against it.

If you were already next to your Soulmate before you used this ability, the mana cost is reduced by 1.
data.requirement: Your soulmate is the target of an attack and is within the range of this ability.

data.name: Quick Getaway
data.description: You may move as if you had spent 2 AP on the movement action. Combo: If used after Feint or the Disengage action, the AP cost of this is reduced by 2.

data.name: Quick Revive
data.description: You immediately resummon the summon from your Summon Animal that was killed in this current encounter. If multiple of your summons have died, you summon the one that died most recently.

data.name: Quickdraw
data.description: You may draw a pistol and make a Light Attack with the drawn pistol against the target. The target may not react to this shot.

data.name: Quickdraw Alchemy
data.description: You draw an Alchemy item from your combat inventory.

data.name: Radiant Halo
data.description:
You Heal all allied targets in a 15ft radius from the target point for 11 + (2 x Power).

You may use 1 RP instead of 2 AP for this ability. When using RP on this ability, you may use it even when it is not your turn.

data.name: Radiant Verdict
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target that deals Holy damage. On hit, inflict Sanctify 1

data.name: Rage Stance
data.description: You enter a Stance in which you prioritize offense over defense. The Stance lasts until the encounter ends, you get Downed or up to an hour. While the Stance lasts, gain 2 additional AP that can only be used on melee attacks each turn (including the turn you use this), but cannot use actions that use RP other than attack of opportunity unless they have the Rage keyword. You also cannot use abilities with the Spell keyword, unless they also have the Rage keyword. You are treated as having 0 RP for abilities with that as a requirement. While in your Rage Stance, you gain a +1 bonus to Guard and a +5 bonus to all Fitness checks.

data.name: Raise Undead
data.description:
You raise the target corpse as a basic undead, such as a zombie. This zombie is treated as a non-heroic unit that you can command directly. You can have multiple zombies under your command, up to your Necromancer level + 1. However, the zombies act as a group under the same token rather than having an individual token. The group acts on your Initiative.

Each zombie has a single point of HP and immediately dies, but you only lose 1 zombie per attack the group takes, including AoE attacks that do not deal Holy Damage. AoE attacks that deal Holy damage remove a number of zombies equal to the damage taken. The zombie group has a focus and power of 3 + 1 for every 3 zombies, rounded down. They have an Agility of 2 and Toughness equal to 4. They have access to all basic actions, but otherwise have no special abilities. As a non-heroic entity, they only have access to a single RP. Because they are undead, they are immune to all mind-affecting effects.

A raised undead lasts until the end of the arc or until killed, after which the corpse cannot be raised again in any way.
data.requirement: Target must be a dead humanoid.

data.name: Raise Undead II
data.description:
You raise the target corpse as a basic undead, such as a zombie. This zombie is treated as a non-heroic unit that you can command directly. You can have multiple zombies under your command, up to your Necromancer level + 1. However, the zombies act as a group under the same token rather than having an individual token. The group acts on your Initiative.

Each zombie has a single point of HP and immediately dies, but you only lose 1 zombie per attack the group takes, including AoE attacks that do not deal Holy Damage. AoE attacks that deal Holy damage remove a number of zombies equal to the damage taken. The zombie group has a focus and power of 3 + 1 for every 3 zombies, rounded down. They have an Agility of 2 and Toughness equal to 4. They have access to all basic actions, but otherwise have no special abilities. As a non-heroic entity, they only have access to a single RP. Because they are undead, they are immune to all mind-affecting effects.

A raised undead lasts until the end of the arc or until killed, after which the corpse cannot be raised again in any way.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 Mana to raise a non-humanoid corpse.

data.name: Rapid Correction
data.description: You turn your Light attack into a Precise attack.
data.requirement: You miss with a ranged weapon Light attack.

data.name: Rappelling Dagger
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you may move to the closest available spot within 5ft of the target. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Can be used against non-living objects and the on damage part always applies when used in that way.
data.requirement: Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack only.

data.name: Receive Oracle
data.description: You seek divine knowledge on a topic and can ask up to three yes or no questions. You then receive a vision on the answers from an unknown entity. The GM chooses the information you receive. You regain the use of Receive Oracle after a rest.

data.name: Reckless Strike
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.

data.name: Redirected Force
data.description:
You redirect the incoming attack back onto the attacker, using the same attack roll. The attacker may react to this attack as normal.

Can not be used against the same attack used to enter the Serene Water stance.
data.requirement: Must be in Serene Water stance and after a melee attack against you missed.

data.name: Redistribute
data.description:
You may transfer temporary HP from a single willing ally within range to any number of other allies within range. The total amount of temporary HP must be the same after the transfer.

May only redistribute temporary HP you applied through the use of a Shieldwarden or Veilguard ability. Does not affect temporary HP added through Reinforce.

data.name: Refreshing Stream
data.description: You cast this ability on water within range, recovering fatigue and granting a target within 15ft of that point 1 RP.  The target cannot go over their max RP from this.

data.name: Regrowing Limbs
data.description: You regrow a lost limb, restoring it to full use.

data.name: Regrowth
data.description: You use nature's power to place Regrowth on an ally that lasts until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Reinforce Armor
data.description:
Until the start of your next turn, the guard and block value gained from an armor and shield you crafted and are wearing is doubled.

Does not affect armor plates.
data.requirement: Must be wearing armor or a shield you crafted.

data.name: Repair Armor
data.description: Errand. You repair a broken armor.

data.name: Repair Artifice
data.description: Errand. You repair a broken artifice.

data.name: Repair Weapon
data.description: Errand. You repair a broken smithing weapon.

data.name: Repair Wood Weapon
data.description: Errand. You repair a broken carpentry weapon.

data.name: Rescue
data.description: You Teleport a willing ally within range to an empty square next to you. If the target is mounted, you may also teleport their mount together with the target.

data.name: Rescue & Drop
data.description:
You pick up a willing ally and put them on your mount. They travel with you on the back of your mount until either you or they spend 0 AP or 1 RP to place them back on the ground. An ally that is being rescued can not take any other actions until they are dropped.

Only 1 ally can be rescued at a time.

data.name: Resheathe
data.description: You regain the Iai state. In addition, your next Iai strike this encounter gains Full Pierce.

data.name: Resist Poison
data.description: You gain Resist Poison, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 against the triggering damage. You also resist the application of the poison, negating its effect.
data.requirement: You're about to take Poison damage or become afflicted with a Poison.

data.name: Resistant Venom
data.description: Your Poison effects gain Persist 1.

data.name: Revealing Light
data.description: You clap your hands and send out a pulse of solar light in a 40ft radius around you. All creatures within that range are immediately revealed, canceling any stealth, invisibility or similar technique to hide themselves. They glow brightly until the start of your next turn, giving them a -20 penalty to stealth checks.

data.name: Reverse Polarity
data.description: You invert the roll result. (1 becomes 10, 2 becomes 9 etc)

data.name: Ricochet
data.description: You may make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) Attack against the target. The target does not benefit from Light Cover against this attack.

data.name: Rider & Mount As One
data.description: While you are mounted and not flying you and your mount are considered the same entity for the purposes of what can target you. This means that while you are mounted, your mount cannot be targeted by anything (including allied effects) unless the effect specifically says it does. Any debuff or buff on you also affects your mount's movement and speed as if it was placed on the mount.

data.name: Riposte
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that you used your Parry ability against.
data.requirement: May only be used after you use the Parry fencer ability and you regained the RP.

data.name: Riposte II
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that you used your Parry ability against.
data.requirement: May only be used after you use the Parry fencer ability and you regained the RP.

data.name: Rock Fang
data.description: Make a heavy attack against the target. On damage the target is affected by Armor Sunder 2, reducing their guard by 2 until the start of your next turn. This attack also immediately benefits from the Sunder effect.

data.name: Rocket Jump
data.description: You fire your cannon behind you and use the momentum to sidestep 10ft. This movement does not reduce the range of your cannon.

data.name: Ruminant Metabolism
data.description: You can go a day without eating before starvation applies.

data.name: Running Shot
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target.
data.requirement: Must be mounted and taking a movement action.

data.name: Rushing Knee Drop
data.description: You may spend either 1 AP or 1 RP to leap up to 15 ft and crush a prone enemy within 5ft with a knee attack, dealing Light Damage. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

data.name: Ryujin's Mastery
data.description: You gain one of Elemental Mastery of your choice from the following options: Fire, Water, Ice, Wind, Lightning, or Earth.

data.name: Sable Grace
data.description: You take the Dodge action against the triggering attack. You remove Lock-On from this attack and treat your Dodge as 99 against it.
data.requirement: You become the target of an attack. Can only be used during the night.

data.name: Sacrament
data.description: You touch one willing ally’s or your own weapon and bless it. Until the end of the encounter, the weapon deals Holy Damage and grants a +1 Power Enchantment.

data.name: Sanctity Aura
data.description:
You project an aura 30ft around you that blesses your allies.

When an ally makes an attack as part of one of your Gun Paladin abilities, they may choose to make the damage type of that attack the same as your Holy Weapon damage type.

data.name: Sapping Ward
data.description: A ward that can be placed on a normal-sized room or can be combined to ward off a house or larger area. Each ward can cover a 20ft radius and for each Sapping Ward placed in the same area as another Sapping Ward, this radius increases by 20ft (For example, 60ft with 3 Sapping Wards) If someone other than you enters the area, they must make a save against your Potency or become Weakened. Non-heroic units that enter the area must make a save or become Stunned instead. These conditions last while they remain inside the field and for an additional 2 rounds after exiting it. Casting this takes 10 minutes of uninterrupted casting. Once triggered, the field remains active for 5 more minutes before vanishing. You may at the time of casting choose a number of people equal to your Focus that can enter the area without triggering the ward. If not triggered, Sapping Ward lasts until you remove it. While it remains, your maximum mana is reduced by 2 for each instance of Sapping Ward you have active. This is considered a tier 2 ward.

data.name: Saprophytic Bolt
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target, dealing Earth damage. On damage, the current host of Spore Symbiote is Healed for your Power + 3.

data.name: Scarecrow's Gaze
data.description: You summon the appearance of whatever someone fears the most. Every enemy within range must make a Save against your potency. On failure, they may not walk closer to you until the start of your next turn unless they have no valid targets to attack without doing so.

data.name: Scent
data.description: You gain a +5 Expertise bonus to Perception (Smell).

data.name: Scent of Blood
data.description: You sniff the air and become aware of all targets within range that have below half of their maximum HP. This does not reveal their HP percentage.

data.name: Schadenfreude
data.description: You redirect an attack to another ally in range of the triggering attack. If they don't react to this, your next Malevolent  Phantasm ignores the requirement and costs no mana.

data.name: Scorching Reprisal
data.description: You make a Heavy attack of opportunity against the target. Your next basic attack of opportunity against that target before the start of your next turn costs 0 RP.
data.requirement: An enemy provokes an attack of opportunity.

data.name: Scout's Retreat
data.description: You disengage and may move up to two times your speed away from enemies towards the closest escape point.

data.name: Scouting Ahead
data.description: When traveling stealthily across the map, you can choose to move slightly ahead of the party when moving. If you do, you treat your roll as the lowest roll of the party.

data.name: Scry
data.description:
You designate a point that you can see within range, creating a magical ward at that point.  If you focus you can shift your perception to that ward and see and hear everything within line of the sight of that ward in a 30ft radius.  The ward can persist as long as you want over any distance, but you can only have one instance of Scry active at a time.

The ward is invisible and inaudible, but can be detected through magical means.

data.name: Scurry Away
data.description: After using the Disengage or Feint action, your movement speed increases by 10ft until the end of your turn.

data.name: Seal Cloak
data.description: You manifest and don a seal cloak that has been with you since you were born, transforming you into your Seal Form.  While in seal form you gain a swim speed of 80 feet but you can only take basic actions while in Seal Form and you are proficient in melee attacking without weapons in seal form.  While in Seal Form, you can hold your breath underwater for up to 2 hours and your land speed is reduced to 5.  You can remove the cloak for 0 AP.

data.name: Sealing Talisman
data.description: You attach a Sealing Talisman to the target. Non-heroics become Stunned immediately, while heroic targets must spend 2 AP to remove it from themselves. If they do not remove it by the end of their turn, they become Stunned. While the talisman remains attached, the target is stunned. Anyone within touching distance of the talisman may spend 2 AP to remove the talisman, immediately removing the stun effect. If the talisman is not removed, it lasts until the end of encounter or until the target takes damage. A person can only be affected by 1 Sealing Talisman at a time.
data.requirement: The target has 0 RP. Must have a Sealing Talisman in hand.

data.name: Second Tremor
data.description: The enemy falls prone and takes Light damage.
data.requirement: An enemy stands up from prone or takes falling damage without falling prone.

name: Secret Art ~ Faerie Light Eyes: Jade Shelterbelt

data.name: Secret Art ~ Faerie Light Eyes: Jade Shelterbelt
data.description:
Creates 5 Illusionary Heavy Spin Fluttering Blades within 20ft from you that last until the end of the encounter. 

They are dispelled when Fluttering Blade is cancelled on them.

These do not count towards your Fluttering Blade limit.

data.name: Secret Art:  Revitalize
data.description:
You pray for a Downed ally. The ally’s HP becomes 0 and then heals for your Power x 3. They may stand up from prone after this healing.

Overcharge: You may pay X extra mana to make the target heal + 7 HP for every additional point of mana spent. 

This ability does not work on Mortally Wounded allies.

data.name: Secret Art: 7 Points of Death
data.description: You make a number of Precise Attacks up to the amount of Marks of Death on the target. Each attack deals damage equal to your Focus + Power instead of rolling for damage.
data.requirement: Target is below half HP and has at least 1 Mark of Death.

data.name: Secret Art: Absolute Compression
data.description: You make an attack against the target that deals Double Heavy Physical(Crushing) damage.

data.name: Secret Art: All of Creation
data.description: Change the damage type of the target attack into any damage type except True.

data.name: Secret Art: Ambush Shot
data.description: You make a Heavy attack that does maximum damage instead of rolling. This attack does not break your stealth.
data.requirement: Enemy must be unaware of your presence. Can only be used on the first turn of an encounter and must be your first attack.

data.name: Secret Art: Anima Synthesis Form
data.description:
You consume a gene and transform, granting yourself all abilities of the chimera subrace of that corresponding gene. 

This lasts until the end of the encounter. 

In addition, learning this skill grants you +1 to your gene inventory for the Biohacking skill. Despite being transformed, you can still use Gene Activation to add additional abilities.

You cannot obtain and use abilities that require an IP or EP to use through this ability.
data.requirement: Must have the required gene in your gene inventory.

name: Secret Art: Arlan Heaven's Fall Dive

data.name: Secret Art: Arlan Heaven's Fall Dive
data.description: Your next Airship shot gains Sure Hit and Full Pierce.
data.requirement: You have 100 or more strafe and just lost 100ft of altitude. Must be on an aerial staff in Aerial mode.

data.name: Secret Art: Assassinate
data.description:
You attack the target for Heavy Damage. 

If you surprised the enemy, are currently stealthed and have not been spotted by an enemy this entire encounter, this attack deals double heavy damage. You may move next to an enemy and still qualify as being stealthed and not spotted, provided you use this ability immediately after that movement ends.
data.requirement: Target must be marked by Death Mark. One-handed weapons only.

data.name: Secret Art: Beaver Timber Fang
data.description: Make a normal heavy attack against the target. Afterwards make a light attack against the target with Sure Hit that immediately renders the target prone, even if the damage is reduced to 0.

data.name: Secret Art: Bestial Wrath
data.description: Your summon gains Bestial Wrath and AP equal to its maximum AP they may immediately use. Bestial Wrath gives +2 Focus and +2 Power and prevents the summon from dropping below 1 HP. This effect lasts for 3 rounds or until the summon is reduced to 1 HP.

data.name: Secret Art: Black Hole
data.description:
You create a Black Hole at a target location within range. When you cast this and when you pay upkeep, all enemies within 120ft of the black hole must make a save or get pulled 20ft towards it.

All enemies within 120ft of the black hole that are moving away from it are considered slowed for that movement.

Upkeep: 1 Mana. Instead of paying upkeep, you may detonate the Black Hole making a Heavy attack against all enemies within 15ft of the black hole.

data.name: Secret Art: Bladestorm
data.description:
You enter a stance in which you continuously spin your weapon around your body. When activating this ability, you may make a Heavy attack against all enemies within your melee weapon range. While the stance lasts you may make a Heavy attack against all enemies within your melee weapon range at the start of your turn.

You can move while in this stance. If you move close enough to an enemy for them to be within your melee weapon range, you may make a Heavy attack against them.

You can only attack a creature once per round through this ability, regardless of how many times you move closer to them.

Upkeep: 2 Mana, 1 AP

data.name: Secret Art: Bloody Ritual
data.description:
You create a blood tether to all enemies within range, causing them to be Slowed. The tether lasts until the start of your next turn or until they move out of the range of this ability.

At the start of your next turn, the tethers explode, dealing Heavy damage to all tethered enemies as it sucks the life energy from them. For every enemy dealt damage with this ability, you recover 1 Mana or 5 HP (your choice). If an enemy dies while under the effect of the tether but before it explodes, you also gain this regeneration effect.

data.name: Secret Art: Chase the Horizon
data.description:
You focus on a single enemy and maintain a constant position from them. Whenever the target moves, you may move the same amount as they did (up to your movement speed) away from them for 0 RP. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target, but does provoke from other enemies.

 Every time this happens, you may make a Light attack against the target with a ranged weapon. If the target spends multiple AP on a single movement action, you may make an amount of Light attacks equal to the AP they spent.

Lasts until the start of your next turn or until you can no longer see the target.

data.name: Secret Art: Checkmate
data.description: You may move all your pieces as if you used Move Piece on them.

data.name: Secret Art: Divine Judgement
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack that deals Holy damage against the target. If your target’s HP is lower than the max damage your attack would deal, this attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage instead of rolling.

This calculation only involves your base damage (Base weapon damage + the power). Any other effects added to the damage such as Heavy Blade's bonus damage, Anathema on target etc do not affect the calculation and aren't maximized.

An enemy reduced to 0 HP or lower with this ability is immediately killed.
data.requirement: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

data.name: Secret Art: Divine Shield
data.description:
Until the start of your next turn, you gain Damage Reduction 1000 against all damage types, but you only deal half damage.

You gain 2 AP.

Must be used as the first action in your turn.

data.name: Secret Art: Double Accel
data.description: You gain 4 AP. Your AP recovery is lowered by 3 until the end of your next turn.

data.name: Secret Art: Dragonslaying Jump
data.description: You Jump up to the target, not provoking any attacks of opportunity, and make a Heavy Attack against it. On damage, the target plummets to the ground taking falling damage as normal. Overcharge: You may spend additional AP on this ability to increase the range by 60ft for every extra AP spent. If this increases the AP cost to more than what you currently have, it gains the Setup keyword.
data.requirement: Target must be airborne, polearm only.

data.name: Secret Art: Dynamic Duo
data.description: You challenge all enemies in range until the start of your next turn. Any time you would be allowed to make an Attack of Opportunity, your Soulmate may make it instead. They may Sidestep up to their speed before making each Attack of Opportunity.

data.name: Secret Art: Earthquake
data.description:
You make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against all enemies in range that are touching the ground. On damage, they fall prone.

You also make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against all magically created walls and similar inanimate objects created by magic. You deal 10x damage against those targets.

data.name: Secret Art: Efficient Spirit Control
data.description:
You reduce the cost of your next non-healing keyword action by 2 mana. This cannot reduce the mana cost below 0.

Also resets your Circuits, allowing abilities with the Circuit keyword to be used for their reduced mana cost once more.

data.name: Secret Art: Endless Waltz
data.description:
You make two Light Attacks against the same target. On damage, make another another light attack.

Killing Blow: You may move up to twice your speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

data.name: Secret Art: Entropic Magic Pulse
data.description:
You send out a wave of energy that disrupts spirit circuits that cancels all temporary magic effects in range. All non-permanent effects within range that are created by an ability with the Spell or Enchantment keyword are affected. Spells that do not have a time limit listed or create a permanent effect such as a Geomancer's fissure are not affected.

Bounded Fields and Secret Arts cannot be removed by this ability.

In addition, artifices cannot be used by anyone except you until the end of your next turn.

name: Secret Art: Everything, Everywhere, All At Once

data.name: Secret Art: Everything, Everywhere, All At Once
data.description:
You make a Heavy Attack against the enemy. 

You may then repeat this attack from each of your past selves and may target the same enemy multiple times.

data.name: Secret Art: Fan the hammer
data.description: You may make 4 Heavy Attacks against the target. Afterwards, the weapon used for this ability cannot be used again until the end of the encounter.

data.name: Secret Art: Forbid
data.description:
You choose a target and pick between basic actions or abilities. 

Until the start of your next turn, any time the target does the chosen action, they take Full Pierce damage equal to your Focus per AP spent on it.

data.name: Secret Art: Full Combo
data.description:
Your allies gain +4 Song bonus to their damage rolls. This is doubled on Heavy attacks.

If an ally misses an attack, this bonus is reduced to +1.

Upkeep: 1 AP

data.name: Secret Art: Gae Bolg
data.description:
Make a Heavy attack against the target. Unless your accuracy roll is a 1, your roll is treated as if you rolled a 20 and it gains Sure Hit. 

It is treated as a critical hit even though it's Sure Hit, unless the target blocks.

data.name: Secret Art: Galaxy Stop
data.description: You create a space-time anomaly that freezes time itself in a local area for a short while, affecting all but the strong-willed.  All non-heroic units in range cannot take any actions until the end of their next turn.

data.name: Secret Art: Gate of Fate
data.description: You subvert fate and a bad end, twisting reality into its most fortunate outcome.  When a target ally rolls a 1, you can instead change it to a 20.

data.name: Secret Art: Guiding Shot
data.description:
You may make a Heavy attack against the target. The target may spend 1 RP to avoid the attack. If they do, you may Sidestep them up to 20ft in a direction of your choice and then trigger a Place Trap effect, provided you have at least one set up.

This trap effect does not count towards your per encounter limitation. You may not Sidestep an enemy into a hazard (such as off a cliff or into fire) apart from your trap, unless the target has nowhere else to go.

Alternatively, you may choose to move an enemy into a Bear Trap you set up within the 20ft movement instead of a Place Trap effect. You can only choose one of these two options, not both.

data.name: Secret Art: Jade Skin
data.description: You take the Block action against the triggering attack. If you reduce the damage to 0, the attacker becomes Disarmed until the start of their next turn.
data.requirement: You are attacked by a Melee attack.

data.name: Secret Art: Life Bet
data.description:
You reduce your HP to 1 and make a Heavy attack against the target. You gain a bonus to the damage roll of this attack equal to the amount of HP you lost through this ability.

If this attack fails to meet the base evasion of the target, the HP you lost is refunded. It still counts as your one secret art use of the fight regardless.

data.name: Secret Art: Life Sacrifice
data.description:
You lose HP until your HP reaches 1. Target ally within range recovers that much HP. Any HP that exceeds the target’s max HP becomes temporary HP.

This HP loss cannot be mitigated in any way and ignores temporary HP. This does not trigger effects that would trigger upon taking damage.

data.name: Secret Art: Lifesaver
data.description: The target gains temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to their missing HP.

data.name: Secret Art: Lightning Field
data.description:
You conjure a statically charged field around you, applying Static X where X equals your Focus x 3 to all enemies within 30ft of you. Enemies already afflicted by Static immediately take damage equal to 3 + half the static value. While within your Lightning Field, the Static on enemies is not removed at the end of their turn.

This field lasts until the end of your next turn.

Upkeep: You may pay 1 Mana at the start of your turn to repeat the initial effect and extend the duration of the field by 1 turn.

data.name: Secret Art: Lightning Release
data.description:
You infuse yourself with Lightning and gain Lightning Release until the end of the encounter, allowing you to deal Lightning damage with your unarmed attacks and immediately enter the Heavenly Lightning Stance. While this lasts, you also gain the following benefits: 

  • Your movement speed is doubled.
  • You can make an additional attack when you use Double Punch. 
  • When making an unarmed attack, your critical threshold is lowered by 1 (19-20 base). Whenever you hit with a critical hit with an unarmed attack that deals Lightning damage, the attack arcs to a different enemy within 20ft of the original target. This attack uses the same attack roll and damage, but cannot arc again.

If you ever leave the Lightning Stance, you lose the benefit of this.

data.name: Secret Art: Manifest
data.description:
You summon a Manifestation of yourself. When initially summoned, it is attached to your body and shares your space.

While this transformation lasts, you are able to move the manifestation and command it to take special attacks. Your Manifestation uses your own stats for any offenses.

This Manifestation takes up no space and both allies and enemies can pass through it. However, when an enemy passes through the Manifestation’s space, you may make an opportunity attack against that enemy. A manifestation is untargetable through normal means.

A manifestation must remain within 20ft of you. If you or it moves out of range while it is on the field, it forcefully snaps back to you and becomes unusable until the end of your next turn.

You may recall your Manifestation and attach it back to you for 0 AP. While attached to you, it moves with you.

May be used as an encounter start instead of paying the AP cost.

data.name: Secret Art: Meteor
data.description:
You mark a 30x30ft area and begin summoning a meteor to strike it at the start of your next turn. Those in the area when it lands take Heavy Fire Damage. 

Overcharge: You may spend extra AP on this ability to increase the damage and size of it. For every extra 2 AP spent on it, the size increases by 5ft and the damage increases by your Power. If the Overcharge increases the AP cost to above 4, this ability gains the Setup keyword. You mark the area of this ability when you have finished spending all AP on it and not before. The maximum AP you can spend on this ability is 16 AP.

data.name: Secret Art: Moving Castle
data.description:
You project a defensive aura up to 15ft around you, granting all allies (excluding yourself) the Bulwark buff. While under the effects of Bulwark, allies take 3 less damage.

While projecting this aura, you may spend 0 RP to sidestep up to your movement. After you do so, you may not do so again until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: You must spend 1 mana at the start of your turn to continue this effect.

data.name: Secret Art: Mushroomize
data.description:
You fill your target with mycelium from your spore symbiote, removing the Downed state from them and preventing them from entering the downed State while this effect lasts. Removing Spore Symbiote from the target cancels this effect. This effect ends at the start of your next turn unless you spend 1 mana to continue the effect.  When paying upkeep, if the target is below 0 HP, heal the target for your power + 3.

This effect ends if the target’s HP is reduced to negative their maximum HP amount.

You can use 1 RP instead of 2 AP to use this ability.
data.requirement: Must be used on your Spore Symbiote target that is in the Downed state.

data.name: Secret Art: Mythical Awakening
data.description:
You channel your power into your mount, allowing it to unleash a devastating attack based on what type of mount it is.

Pegasus: Bellerophon: You Sidestep towards a target within 60ft and make a Heavy attack against it. This attack has Lock-on and costs 1 RP and 2 Mana

Wyvern: Reginliev: You make a Heavy attack against all enemies in a 5ft wide line up to a point within 60ft. You also make a Heavy attack against all enemies within 10ft of the selected point, though enemies can also take an attack from this ability once. This attack costs 2 AP and 2 Mana.

Dragonfly: Darting Mirage: You move at incredible speed and create several illusionary afterimages in your wake. Until the start of your next turn, every attack against you or your mount that is not a critical hit or does not have the Sure Hit keyword  automatically misses. This is an Illusion effect. This ability costs 0 AP and 4 Mana.

All these attacks are made with your mount’s stats instead of your own.
data.requirement: Must be mounted on a mount mentioned in the description.

data.name: Secret Art: Nightcaller
data.description: Until the end of the encounter, it is considered night for all your abilities and items that are affected by it.

data.name: Secret Art: Overcharge
data.description: Reduces the mana cost of your next Spell cast this turn by 3. You cannot gain mana from this.

data.name: Secret Art: Override
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against all enemies in a line and move through them. You keep moving through enemies until you reach an empty spot you can stand in. If there is no valid end position due to an ally occupying the spot or terrain (such as a wall) being in the way, you cannot use this ability.

data.name: Secret Art: Perfect Repetition
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage, on the next turn, you may repeat this attack against the same target using the same accuracy check as the initial attack. You may continue to repeat this attack on subsequent turns until you spend a turn not using this move or if the attack fails to deal damage.

data.name: Secret Art: Pyroblast
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals double Heavy Fire Damage. This attack gains Lock On against a target that has the Burning condition that you inflicted on it.

data.name: Secret Art: Razor Hurricane
data.description: You create a rapid spinning hurricane with a 15x15 size and 50ft in height in the target location. All creatures caught in the hurricane immediately take Wind Light Damage and are pushed out of the Hurricane. Every creature that enters the hurricane immediately takes Wind Light Damage and must succeed at a save against your Potency or be pushed back 20ft. Leaving the hurricane does no damage and requires no save. Upkeep: You must spend 1 Mana and 2 AP at the start of each turn or the spell ends. When you pay this Upkeep, you may move the hurricane up to 20ft. Any creature that comes into contact with the hurricane during this move takes damage and must make a save as if they had entered it.

data.name: Secret Art: Rewind
data.description: You rewind time to before your last action. All results based on your last action are reversed- All HP, Mana, AP and RP are returned to how they were. The ability you used in that action is no longer considered used, but this ability is.
data.requirement: Can only be used on your turn.

name: Secret Art: Ride of the Valkyrie

data.name: Secret Art: Ride of the Valkyrie
data.description:
You Sidestep up to your speed and can move through enemies for this movement. You and every ally you pass through are healed for 11 + (Power x 2).

This movement must always be in a straight line, regardless of your mount type.

data.name: Secret Art: Seventeen Dissection
data.description:
You deal 17 true damage to the target. If this damage lowers the target’s HP to 0 or lower, they immediately die.
If the target of this attack is a non-heroic unit, they instantly die regardless of their remaining HP.

data.name: Secret Art: Shatter
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target using a Blacksmith’s Hammer. If the target chooses to Block the attack, they gain 100 damage reduction against it. If they do, choose one equipped non-divine arms weapon in their hand that has equal or less crafted enhancements than your hammer and destroy that item, giving it the Broken condition.
data.requirement: Attack must be made with a Blacksmith's Hammer.

data.name: Secret Art: Shield Wall
data.description: You and your allies in range gain Shield Wall, which reduces the damage they take from the triggering attack by 75.
data.requirement: Usable when you are the target of an ability that affects an area, using a shield.

data.name: Secret Art: Shock & Awe
data.description:
You and up to 3 other allies within range gain 3 AP they must spend immediately. On their next turn, they regain 1 less AP.

These AP may not be spent on Setup abilities and normal once per turn ability limitations apply.

name: Secret Art: Shot From The Blue

data.name: Secret Art: Shot From The Blue
data.description:
You recall hiring a sniper specifically for a situation like this. 

The sniper mercenary, off screen, takes a single shot at the target before retreating. You grant the signal, and the sniper fires, dealing heavy damage with full pierce and sure hit to the target. This shot uses the stats from the Sniper NPC, attacking with +6 Accuracy (if relevant) and dealing 4d6+10 damage.

Shot From The Blue does not gain Sure Hit and Full Pierce against targets with Instinct.

If the target is a grunt, kill them instantly.
data.requirement: Target is outdoors or reasonably visible from outdoors. Costs 500 Clim to use.

data.name: Secret Art: Skeletal Champion
data.description:
You drain the surrounding area of energy and form a skeletal champion until the end of the encounter. (Stats can be found in the Monster page)

This champion takes 2 of your summon limit. Any zombies you had active when you summoned this are instead converted into temporary HP for the champion at a rate of 5 HP per zombie.

The champion acts after you on the initiative, but cannot take AP actions on the turn it is summoned.

Upkeep: 2 AP

Overcharge: You may spend 5 mana to give your summon the ability to act on the turn it is summoned.

data.name: Secret Art: Spectrum Blade
data.description:
Until the end of the encounter, you enchant your weapon with every single element. When using Elemental Strike or Elemental Sweep, you may choose which effect you want regardless of the damage type your attack deals. When you deal damage, you apply the damage type that would deal the most damage.

In addition, your weapon gains a +1 Power bonus until the end of the encounter. If it already had a +1 Power bonus through an enchantment, this bonus is instead increased to +2.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

data.name: Secret Art: Spirit Stigma
data.description: You stigmatize the targets spirit, they are inflicted with Spirit Stigma until the start of your next turn. A target with Spirit Stigma counts as a willing ally for your Eremancer abilities and damaging them fulfills the Malevolent  Phantasm requirement.

data.name: Secret Art: Summon Eidolon
data.description:
Your contracted Eidolon hears your call and sends a proxy of themselves to fight for you.  The Eidolon called and the costs are dependent on your attunement.  Lasts up to 5 minutes.  You must pay the upkeep cost under the Eidolon’s Summon Skill or the Eidolon vanishes.

Unless the summon has a skill that says otherwise, a summon acts after you on initiative, but cannot act the round it is summoned, except for RP actions.

Overcharge: You may spend 5 mana to give your summon the ability to act on the turn it is summoned.

data.name: Secret Art: Surge of Elements
data.description:
You channel all masteries of the elements and fire a barrage of elemental bolts at the target.

You make 7 light attacks, doing Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Wind, Lightning and Earth damage respectively.

Overcharge: You may spend one more mana to make additional Light attacks, one that does Holy damage and one that does Dark damage.

data.name: Secret Art: The Grand Theater
data.description:
All allies within range may sidestep up to their movement speed.

You may Sidestep all enemies within range up to their movement speed.

After all targets have moved, everyone that was originally in range of this ability immediately gains 2 AP they must spend on attacks against other creatures if possible.

data.name: Secret Art: Titan Blade
data.description:
You greatly increase the size and weight of your weapons, then slam them down in a direction. You make a melee Heavy attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide line up to the range. On damage, a target is knocked prone.

 

After the initial hit, a shockwave follows. You make another Heavy attack against any enemy still in the original line’s range. This second attack has the Sure Hit and Full Pierce qualities against a prone target.
data.requirement: Must be wielding two Two-Handed melee weapons.

data.name: Secret Art: Transmute Proto Armatae
data.description:
You touch the ground, transmuting a Proto Armatae of your own design.  The Proto Armatae lifts you up and immediately encases you into its cockpit.   The Proto Armatae is 15ft tall and is a large creature that occupies a 15ftx15ft space.  All creatures and moveable objects surrounding the Proto Armatae are pushed back away from its zone of control in a burst of steam.  The Armatae also gains a temporary shield with 20 HP that disappears at the start of your next turn.

You must use your own actions to cause the Proto Armatae to move and attack.  You can eject from a transmutation hatch on the top at the center of the Proto Armatae for 1 AP, in which the Proto Armatae stops functioning.  When you re-enter you must close the hatch for 1 AP before the Proto Armatae functions again. 

The Proto Armatae has health equal to 15 + 5x Focus and it uses your AP and RP for actions.  You can channel your Transmuter abilities through the Proto Armatae, and Transmute Weapon can create a giant sized weapon for the Armatae to use.

You may also spend 1 RP to use this ability instead of the AP cost.

Only usable once.  You regain the use of this ability when you gain an Interlude Point.

 

Proto Armatae

HP: –

Evasion: 9/19

Guard: 4/14

 

Mini Transmutation Cannon (Right Arm)

Cost: 0 AP

Range: 40ft

Description:  Fires a mini transmutation cannon of deconstructive energy making a light attack against a target.  Doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity.

 

Humanoid Gripper (Left Arm)

Description: Humanoid Gripper can make all basic attacks. It is proficient in any transmuted weapon it holds. Its regular melee attacks deal physical damage and any transmuted weapon it wields gains the benefit of that weapon category.

data.name: Secret Art: True Serenity
data.description: You enter the Serene Water stance and gain an additional +17 bonus to your Evasion until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Secret Art: Tsubame Gaeshi
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target 3 times. On the first miss, the next attacks gain Lock On. On the second miss, the next attack gains Sure Hit. These only apply to attacks made during Tsubame Gaeshi.

data.name: Secret Art: Ultimate Spell
data.description: The next Spell you cast this turn with an AP cost lower than 5 deals true damage.

data.name: Secret Art: Unholy Strength
data.description:
You Gain Unholy Strength which grants +2 Power and Focus. While Unholy Strength is active your attacks/abilities that use your melee weapon to deal physical damage inflict Dark Damage instead and your Bone Armor will not break from damage. 

Upkeep: 1 Mana.

data.name: Secret Art: Unstoppable Onslaught
data.description: You may move up to your speed in a line. All enemies you pass through and all enemies within 15ft of your ending position take Light damage, become Challenged and Shaken until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Secret Art: Vanishing Thousand Steps
data.description:
You may sidestep to a target within range and make a Heavy attack against them. 

Then, until the end of the turn, you may Sidestep to any enemy you can see as part of a melee attack you are about to make. You gain Windflow stacks as if you spent AP on the movement equal to the AP spent on the attack.

data.name: Secret Art: Void
data.description: You target one buff or passive effect you can identify from a grunt or heroic target within range. It is immediately removed and cannot be re-applied for the rest of the encounter.

data.name: Secret Art: Walking Church
data.description: Blesses the target, granting them the status of a church. Until the end of your next turn, the target gains Damage Reduction 1000 against all damage types.

data.name: Secret Art: Whirling Death
data.description:
You enter the Whirling Death stance, spinning wildly and shooting at enemies within range. While in this Stance you may spend 2 AP to make a basic Light Attack with a pistol against all enemies within 20ft.

When you kill an enemy or make them enter the downed state from with this attack, you may repeat the attack.
