data.benefit2: You may use Comet.

data.name: Cloudstep
data.benefit1: You may use Cloudstep.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Controlled Blaze
data.benefit1: When you deal Fire Damage, you may choose not to ignite flammable objects.
data.benefit2: You gain Fire Mastery.

data.name: Controlled Opportunities
data.benefit1: You gain Heavy Armor proficiency.
data.benefit2: When making an attack of opportunity, you gain a +2 bonus to the accuracy and damage roll.

data.name: Controlled Wind
data.benefit1: When pushing a target back or up with a Wind Spell, you may choose to push up to the maximum distance instead of always pushing the maximum distance.

data.name: Cool Spotlight
data.benefit1: Your Idol songs gain +15ft range.  This stacks with other key abilities that increase their range.
data.benefit2: Your One Beat, One Heart song does not count towards your song limit.
data.benefit3: When paying upkeep for One Beat, One Heart, you may spend 1 mana to double its effect.

data.name: Craft Weapons
data.benefit1: You gain Blacksmith Core Crafting Abilities.
data.benefit2: You can craft using the Iron and Tamahagane base materials, as well as any alloys. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
data.benefit3: You can use a Smith’s Hammer as a crafting tool for blacksmithing crafts. You may also use it as a Bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient.
data.benefit4: You gain proficiency in 1 smithing weapon.

data.name: Culinary Basics
data.benefit1: You gain Culinarian Core Crafting Abilities
data.benefit2: You can craft stocks using advanced and base materials. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
data.benefit3: You can use a Frying Pan as a crafting tool for culinarian crafts. You may also use it as a Light Bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient.
data.benefit4: You gain proficiency in small weapons.

data.name: Cultivator's Journey
data.benefit1: Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient.
data.benefit2: You gain proficiency in light armor, light swords and another weapon of your choice.
data.benefit3: You gain +5 skill points to spend in Appraise, Athletics, Deception, Perception, Insight, Medicine, Intimidation, Stealth or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.

data.name: Dark Surge
data.benefit1: After you deal damage to yourself, you gain Dark Surge for your next unarmed attack that turn. Dark Surge gives you +1 Accuracy.

data.name: Dark Weapon
data.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Dark Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

data.name: Death Perception
data.benefit1: You may use Death Perception.
data.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes a Shinigami Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

data.name: Deflect Everything
data.benefit1: You may use your Parry ability against every kind of attack, as well as against Save effects that you could Block.

data.name: Dimensional Armory
data.benefit1: You can create a pocket dimension with Dimensional Armory.  Creating the pocket dimension and establishing its door takes 1 week and costs 1 errand point.  The entry point can be any regular door that you fit through.  When the creator opens this door, they can decide instead to access the Dimensional Armory, which is a 15ft x 15ft closet.  This closet can hold up to 6 Burden worth of items.  Some magic items can be rejected by the dimensional armory (GM’s discretion), such as Divine Arms not bonded to you.  If the owner of a Dimensional Armory dies, everything inside of it appears in the next unoccupied space possible next to the owner.
data.benefit2: Any burden reducing items (such as an alchemy rig) in the armory have no effect. Materials can be stored in the armory at the cost of 1 slot per 1000u of materials.

data.name: Disable Magic
data.benefit1: When using Decipher Magic, you are able to disable both tier 1 and tier 2 level bounded fields.
data.benefit2: You are able to disable or change who is excluded from your own Bounded Fields for 0 RP.

data.name: Discern Immunities
data.benefit1: You may use Discern Immunities.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Divine Weapon
data.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal the damage of your chosen Divine instead. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.
data.benefit2: You may choose to have your weapon emit light as if it was a lantern. You can enable or disable this effect for 1 AP.

data.name: Draw Elements
data.benefit1: You may use Draw Elements.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Draw Elements II
data.benefit1: You may use Draw Elements II.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Earth Weapon
data.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Earth Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare you chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

data.name: Elemental Convergence
data.benefit1: You may use Elemental Convergence.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Emergency Shields
data.benefit1: You may cast Power Word: Shield and Power Word: Guardian Shield (when obtained) by spending 1 RP instead of 2 AP.

data.name: Empty Body
data.benefit1: You may use Empty Body.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Enduring Earth
data.benefit1: You may spend your Encounter Start to enter the Steadfast Earth Stance for 0 mana.
data.benefit2: After entering Steadfast Earth Stance, you keep the benefit until the end of the encounter even if you leave the stance afterwards. After doing so, you are considered to be in Earth Stance for all abilities that require it.
data.benefit3: After using Hardening Fist, you may choose to let the effect last until the end of the encounter. You can still remove the effect for 0 AP.

data.name: Envenom Weapon
data.benefit1: You may use Envenom Weapon.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Eternal Flames
data.benefit1: When you would apply Burning on your turn, you instead apply Hellfire. Hellfire functions like Burning, but it can no longer be removed the normal way if not removed before the end of the target’s next turn. Hellfire can be applied to enemies immune to Burning, but it can still be removed like normal even after a turn has passed. Hellfire is automatically removed at the end of the encounter.
data.benefit2: If you apply Hellfire to a target that is already burning, you deal extra fire damage equal to your Power.

data.name: Eternal Mirane Cage
data.benefit1: You may use Eternal Mirane Cage.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Evil Eye
data.benefit1: While you have a Mystic Eye active, you gain a +10 Mystic Eye bonus to perception checks relying on sight.
data.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes an Evil Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

data.name: Execute the Heretic
data.benefit1: You may use Execute Heretic
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Expanded Circuits
data.benefit1: You gain Expanded Circuits, which gives +2 maximum mana.

data.name: Expanded Menagerie
data.benefit1: You may spend 1 mana with using Summon Animal to choose which animal you summon.
data.benefit2: You add the Cheetah and Landshark to the pool of animals you can summon.

data.name: Expert Alchemist
data.benefit1: You gain Alchemeister Core Crafting Abilities.
data.benefit2: When using Throw Potion, you may infuse it using your own mana. You spend X mana and the mana cost the target needs to pay to benefit from the potion is reduced by X (the mana cost cannot go below 0).

data.name: Expert Farmer
data.benefit1: You may use the Agrarian's core crafting abilities.
data.benefit2: ASSOCIATED ABILITY

data.name: Expert Scribe
data.benefit1: You gain +5 points in Art: Calligraphy expertise skill. This is not doubled for expertise bonus.
data.benefit2: You may draw scrolls, talismans or similar objects for 0 AP once per turn. When you do, reduce the AP cost of that talisman by 1. Even if you do not consume the talisman, it only benefits from the AP reduction once per turn.

data.name: Faerie Light Eyes
data.benefit1: Faerie Light Eyes provide protection against Illusions, giving you the ability to immediately see the reality warping distortions that illusions cause.  The user is not only notified of illusions, but immune to all but your own.
data.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes a Faerie Light Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

data.name: Fallen Friend
data.benefit1: When an Heroic tier ally reaches 0 HP, you may immediately enter Rage Stance for 0 AP and RP as well as 0 mana. You can use this even if you don’t have the Rage ability yet.

data.name: Fancy Footwork
data.benefit1: You gain proficiency with Dueling Weapons. While wielding a dueling weapon, you also gain the light blades' Nimble ability, even if not wielding or proficient with light blades.
